adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, while the top-level references collection was updated to `filter(...)` (supporting multiple calendar references), the recurring-series cleanup path still deletes only one calendar event per remaining booking. Inside the recurring branch, for each `updBooking` it does `const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"));` and deletes only that single `uid/externalCalendarId`. With multiple calendar references per booking, this will leave other calendar events undeleted (orphaned) on additional destination calendars.
